item_bank.TPB_Behavioral_Intention: I intend to pursue advanced coursework or career paths in this academic domain.
item_bank.TPB_Attitude_Direct: I believe that mastering the material in this academic domain is highly valuable and beneficial to me.
item_bank.TPB_Subjective_Norm: People who are important to me (teachers, family, peers) think that I should succeed in this domain.
item_bank.TPB_Perceived_Control: I am confident that I have the ability, resources, and opportunity to succeed in this course of study.
item_bank.Belong_Community: I feel like a member of the math community.
item_bank.Member_Math_World: I feel like I belong in the math world.
item_bank.Connected_Math: I feel connected to the field of mathematics.
item_bank.Fit_In_Math: I feel like I fit in when I am doing math.
item_bank.Feel_Accepted: I feel accepted by others in math.
item_bank.Feel_Valued: I feel valued in math settings.
item_bank.Feel_Excluded: I feel excluded from math groups or discussions.
item_bank.Feel_Neglected: I feel neglected by instructors or peers in math.
item_bank.Feel_Appreciated: I feel appreciated for my math input.
item_bank.Feel_Anxious: I feel anxious when working on math problems.
item_bank.Feel_Comfortable: I feel comfortable in my math class.
item_bank.Feel_Inadequate: I feel inadequate or not smart enough in math.
item_bank.Feel_At_Ease: I feel at ease during math evaluations.
item_bank.Feel_Tense: I feel tense when I step into a math space.
item_bank.Feel_Confident: I feel confident about my math capabilities.
item_bank.Feel_Stressed: I feel stressed out by math coursework.
item_bank.Trust_Instructors: I trust math instructors to grade me fairly.
item_bank.Trust_Evaluation: I trust math evaluation methods to reflect my true skills.
item_bank.Trust_Materials: I trust that math curriculum materials are designed to help me succeed.
item_bank.No_Need_To_Prove_Self: I feel like I do not need to constantly prove my math ability.
item_bank.Instructors_Committed: I believe math instructors are committed to my progress.
item_bank.Try_To_Say_Little: I try to say as little as possible in math environments.
item_bank.Wish_Invisible: I wish I could be invisible in math classrooms.
item_bank.Fade_To_Background: I try to fade into the background during math lectures.
item_bank.Avoid_Attention: I try to avoid drawing any attention to myself in math spaces.
